How the Brightpath forecasting platform works

The Brightpath forecasting platform turns nightly inventory and point-of-sale feeds into a replenishment quantity for every SKU in every warehouse. Output lands in your ERP by 06:00 local time, seven days a week.

Request a walkthrough

Data we ingest

Brightpath reads three feeds: point-of-sale transactions, on-hand inventory by location, and open purchase orders. Feeds arrive over SFTP or as a REST pull, and the platform needs at least 12 months of SKU-level history before it will publish a forecast.

What the platform returns

Each morning the platform writes one row per SKU per warehouse: recommended order quantity, forecast demand for the next 28 days, and a confidence band. Files are CSV or JSON, and there is a REST endpoint for systems that prefer to pull.

How long implementation takes

Median implementation is 11 working days from contract signature to the first published forecast. The longest stage is feed validation, which takes 4 to 6 working days.

What it costs

The platform is licensed per warehouse. Plans start at $480 per month for up to 5 warehouses. See the pricing page for the full table.
